body.text:
Lantern Lab online community workshop. Each flag (resident, student, member, guardianConsent, scholarship) is independent. All timestamps are UTC; submittedAt is the registration time. Admission requires ALL of the following:
1. age is at least 14; submittedAt is on or after 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z and strictly before 2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z.
2. At least one of resident, student, member, or scholarship is true.
3. A person under 18 without guardianConsent is excluded unless both resident and student are true. That resident-student waiver is suspended on or after 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z, except when BOTH member AND scholarship are true. People aged 18 or older, or with guardianConsent, do not need this waiver.
4. A nonresident submitting on or after 2026-11-25T00:00:00.000Z is excluded unless BOTH member AND scholarship are true.
For admitted people only, charge the FIRST matching fee, in US cents: scholarship: 0; resident AND student: 1200; age under 18: 1600; member: 2600; resident: 3000; otherwise: 4200. Rejected people have no fee.
